name: Cosmic Bolt deals scaling damage to target unit
notes: Cosmic Bolt is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith), same as dwarf-stars-glow-damage. Targets the opponent's champion directly. "Deal 4 damage to target unit plus an additional 2 for each card named CARDNAME in your graveyard and banishment": the resolving Cosmic Bolt is still on the effect stack (the engine parks it in the graveyard early, but the count excludes it), so a lone Cosmic Bolt deals the base 4, not 6. The Starcalling alternate-cost clause is tied to the glimpse subsystem and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Deal 4 damage to target unit plus an additional 2 for each card named CARDNAME in your graveyard and banishment.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Cosmic Bolt counted itself in its own graveyard count (6 damage instead of 4).
